title: Preserve fade-out and volume-swell beat effects
scope: Represent all GPIF Fadding variants while keeping existing FadeIn compatibility explicit.
acceptance: Retain None, FadeIn, FadeOut and VolumeSwell as distinct authored values.
A post-parse change from fade-out to swell exports as the exact target variant.
Unknown source and authored enum values are diagnosed; the existing fade-in case remains supported.
exclusions: GP3 through GP5 FadeOut or VolumeSwell source claims

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Maps each valid Fadding token into the typed public fade authority and import baseline.
Resolves typed and legacy values after import without mutating the public score.
Typed public authority for all four fade values.
Covers GP3-8 import, all enum values, edits, exact output, reimport, validation, diagnostics, strict policy, and read-only behavior.
Pinned AlphaTab verifies the real GP7 fixture and a FadeOut-to-VolumeSwell public edit.
Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[0].voices[0].beats[0].fade. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

resolution: Added BeatFade None, FadeIn, FadeOut, and VolumeSwell. BeatEffects.Fade is the typed authority, and FadeIn remains a compatibility view. GP3-5 fade presence imports as FadeIn. GPIF preserves every valid Fadding token and reports only unknown values. Programmatic nonzero typed values win while legacy true falls back to FadeIn. Imported beats track both source views. Either single-side edit wins, and compatible double edits remain exact. Only incompatible double edits receive gp8.normalize.fade-authority with typed precedence. GP8 emits the resolved exact token without model changes. M10-FADE covers actual GP3-5 Effects and the GP7 fade fixture. It covers all enum values, all compatibility edits, exact output, reimport, validation, and strict policy. Pinned AlphaTab checks source and output facts, including a FadeOut-to-VolumeSwell edit. The probe retained the same 364-fixture set. Only testdata/gp7/fade.gp:fade-other changed, from 3/0 different to 3/3 equal-nondefault. The obsolete two-occurrence Fadding lossy diagnostic was removed. No other capability comparison changed. Dynamics, hairpins, volume controls, automation, playback, and envelope shape remain outside this contract.
